vars.objective: Ring the bells in the west and east galleries to open the stair.
journal: We reached the Noon Spire. Behind the gate it's still Cassian's summer afternoon. The Shards are humming. I'm not scared. (I'm scared.)
The Shards opened the gate by themselves. Cassian said it's a lovely afternoon. It always is.
Evernoon is Aurenne, forty years ago, on the afternoon of a festival. The people here are Remembrances. They sway like a held note.
A frozen procession blocks the cathedral. Sable says the minute is waiting for the clocks. We're going to make the sundials move.
Bram met Sir Aldous, seventeen and terrified of his first watch. Bram told him what Aldous once told him. He called himself a knight. He didn't even stumble over it.
Pip made wind in Evernoon so a kid could fly his kite. He says he wasn't grinning. He was grinning.
Corvin called a forty-year bluff in a tavern in Evernoon. The cards were blank. He looked happier than I've ever seen him.
Ilse cleaned a scraped knee that had been bleeding, painlessly, for forty years. The girl cried, and then she stopped. Ilse called it the best surgery of her career.
Lysa's old nurse tied a ribbon in Sable's hair and said, "Now you look like yourself." Sable said yes. She meant herself.
The market sundial moved one minute. Its guardian was a dancer who never got to stop dancing.
The garden sundial moved one minute. Its guardian was a kite that never came down.
We woke all three sundials. Time moved one minute in Evernoon, and the procession let us pass.
Inside the cathedral it's the night Lysa was lost. Cassian is twelve. I promised him we'd find her. I know how it ends.
We beat the thing that came out of the dark. It didn't matter. His father chose the city, and Lysa was gone anyway. I promised.
I talked to Cassian when he was twelve. He asked if it stops hurting. I told him the truth. He said: tell him I'm sorry I was eating honeycake.
The Grand Lantern, as Cassian remembers it. The stair is barred. Two bells, west gallery and east.

c12_q_aldous.title: The First Watch
c12_q_aldous.desc: Young Squire Aldous Venn lost his mother's tin sun token near the festival fountain (south plaza). Find it for him.

c12_q_kite.title: Wind for Tomas
c12_q_kite.desc: A Remembrance boy in the gardens has never been able to fly his kite — the air in Evernoon is frozen. Bring a Gale Bomb (Mott sells them at the gate).

c12_q_cards.title: Dead Man's Hand
c12_q_cards.desc: Lucky Sel has held "the best hand of his life" for forty years without playing it. Corvin wants a word.

c12_q_knee.title: Scraped Knee
c12_q_knee.desc: Mother Dawe's daughter Fen has a scraped knee that has neither healed nor hurt for forty years. Ilse will look at it (Fen is by the garden pond).

c12_q_ribbon.title: Miss Lysa's Ribbon
c12_q_ribbon.desc: Lysa's old nurse Hollin wants to do "Miss Lysa's" hair. Fetch a gold ribbon from the haberdasher's stall in the market.

c12_q_atlas.title: Where the Sun Goes
c12_q_atlas.desc: A first edition of The Sunward Atlas, inscribed by a twelve-year-old Cassian to his sister. Give it back to its owner.

point.objective: Ring the bells in the west and east galleries to open the stair.
